{{Top|leg}}
The '''Docking Ring''' was the expansive [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] system used by [[Starlyte Station]]. Ringing the equator of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the Docking Ring had two hundred and fifty available berths, capable of handling [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of varying configurations from [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruisers]]. Standard services were on par with [[Imperial-class spaceport]], although prices where generally twenty percent higher.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
